Central  Bank  shall  not  be  required  to  pay  and  credit  any
remaining distributable earnings pursuant to paragraph (c)
of  subsection  (1)  of  section  96  to  the  Consolidated  Fund,
but  such  distributable  earnings  shall  instead  be  applied  to
restore its capital to an unimpaired level:
Provided however, if the capital of the Central Bank is or
continues to be impaired after a period of ten years from the
appointed  date,  the  provisions  of  section  97  shall  be
applicable.

130.
Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraph (a)
of  subsection  (1)  of  section  113,  any  outstanding  credit
granted to credit institutions pursuant to section 88A of the
Monetary Law Act (Chapter 422) and any credit guarantee
given  under  section  108  or  108A  of  the  said  Act  shall  be
maintained under this Act subject to the terms and conditions
as agreed.

131.
Notwithstanding the repeal of the Monetary Law
Act (Chapter 422), the Central Bank shall continue to act as
agent of the Government pursuant to sections 112 and 113
of the repealed Act, which shall be limited only in respect of
